description: A single brown sneaker sits on a wooden tabletop in the corner, with its laces spread out to either side. The left hand and right hand move in to grasp both lace ends as a two-hand object, bring them together over the tongue, cross and pull to tighten, then form loops and wrap one lace around the other; after cinching, both hands pull the lace ends outward to the left and right, loosening and partially undoing the tie.
